description: Risultati sportivi live, classifiche e statistiche da Diretta.it — zero setup, dati offline, MCP pronto.

novel_features.name: Team form digest
novel_features.description: Shows a team's last N results with goals, cards, and venue split — home vs. away — from local cache.

novel_features.name: H2H + odds pivot
novel_features.description: Shows historical head-to-head results alongside live odds for the next scheduled match between two teams.

novel_features.name: Multi-match season export
novel_features.description: Exports every match, statistic, and event for a full season of a competition as CSV or JSON.

novel_features.name: Batch pregame report
novel_features.description: For every match in a league on a given date, shows last-3 H2H and current odds in a single table.

novel_features.name: Standings trend
novel_features.description: Shows how each team's league position changed over the last N weeks using timestamped SQLite snapshots.

novel_features.name: Sync health dashboard
novel_features.description: Reports the age, row counts, and freshness of every SQLite table so automation scripts can detect stale data before acting.

novel_features.name: Team competitions cross-view
novel_features.description: Lists every active competition a team is playing in, with the next fixture date for each — league, cup, and European.

novel_features.name: Raw field explorer
novel_features.description: Dumps the raw FlashScore field-value pairs for any match ID, bypassing the normalizer — for debugging and protocol discovery.
